mapper.select: -- 목록 0건과 삭제·제외·격리 원문을 구분한다. 원문 내용은 읽지 않는다. SELECT id FROM announcement_source_snapshots WHERE id=#{sourceId} AND data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED'
mapper.sql: FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=j.source_id WHERE j.source_id=#{sourceId} AND j.batch_id IS NULL AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND s.semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED'
mapper.select: -- 같은 원문의 모든 일반 작업을 최신순으로 탐색한다. 가능 여부는 개별 preview가 판단한다. SELECT j.source_id,j.id AS job_id,j.operation_code,j.job_status_code,j.application_status_code, j.rollback_status_code,j.normal_rollback_action_id,j.created_at ORDER BY j.created_at DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- 목록과 동일한 범위를 집계하며 실패·미적용·이미 복구한 작업을 숨기지 않는다. SELECT COUNT(j.id)

-- source 소유 범위와 제목 제외 비노출을 확인하며 중앙 DB 근거만 조회한다. SELECT attachment_normal_job_recovery_state(j.id)::text FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=j.source_id WHERE j.id=#{jobId} AND j.source_id=#{sourceId} AND j.batch_id IS NULL AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND s.semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED'
-- 동일 승인 키를 직렬화하며 요청 내용을 바꾼 재사용은 service에서 거부한다. SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(CAST(#{key} AS text),73109))::text
-- 일반 원복은 source→job 순서로 잠근다. SELECT id FROM announcement_source_snapshots WHERE id=#{sourceId} FOR UPDATE
-- 다른 원문/배치 job은 원복 대상으로 사용할 수 없다. SELECT id FROM announcement_attachment_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND batch_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE
-- 동일 키의 불변 영수증을 반환한다. 같은 transaction에서 복구까지 완료된다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_normal_rollback_actions a WHERE a.idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: -- 사유 원문 대신 지문을 기록한다. BEFORE/deferred trigger가 영향과 원자적 완료를 검증한다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_normal_rollback_actions(id,job_id,source_id,mode_code,expected_source_version,expected_attachment_version, preview_hash,is_base_reopened,is_confirmation_restored,actor_id,idempotency_key,request_hash,reason_hash) VALUES(#{id},#{jobId},#{sourceId},#{modeCode},#{expectedSourceVersion},#{expectedAttachmentVersion},#{previewHash},#{baseReopens},#{confirmationRestores},#{actorId},#{key},#{requestHash},#{reasonHash})
mapper.update: -- 원문/운영 공고를 삭제하지 않는다. 승인 직전과 같은 지문·버전에만 이전 binding을 복구한다. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots s SET current_attachment_evaluation_id=j.previous_attachment_evaluation_id, attachment_policy_id=j.previous_policy_id,is_attachment_review_required=j.previous_is_review_required, attachment_row_version=s.attachment_row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM announcement_attachment_normal_rollback_actions a JOIN announcement_attachment_jobs j ON j.id=a.job_id AND j.source_id=a.source_id WHERE a.id=#{actionId} AND s.id=a.source_id AND j.batch_id IS NULL AND j.rollback_status_code='NOT_REQUESTED' AND j.normal_rollback_action_id IS NULL AND s.classification_row_version=a.expected_source_version AND s.attachment_row_version=a.expected_attachment_version AND attachment_normal_job_recovery_state(j.id)->>'previewHash'=a.preview_hash

-- 승인에 고정한 유효 확인만 복구한다. 최초 검수 버전·태그·내용은 불변이다. UPDATE announcement_source_attachment_confirmations c SET is_current=true FROM announcement_attachment_normal_rollback_actions a JOIN announcement_attachment_jobs j ON j.id=a.job_id AND j.source_id=a.source_id WHERE a.id=#{actionId} AND a.is_confirmation_restored AND c.id=j.previous_confirmation_id AND c.source_id=a.source_id AND NOT c.is_current

-- 수집 실패/적용 이력은 원래대로 보존하고 복구 영수증과 증가 버전만 별도 연결한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs j SET normal_rollback_action_id=a.id,rollback_status_code='ROLLED_BACK', restored_source_version=a.expected_source_version,restored_attachment_version=a.expected_attachment_version+1, restored_confirmation_id=CASE WHEN a.is_confirmation_restored THEN j.previous_confirmation_id ELSE NULL END, row_version=j.row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM announcement_attachment_normal_rollback_actions a WHERE a.id=#{actionId} AND j.id=a.job_id AND j.source_id=a.source_id AND j.rollback_status_code='NOT_REQUESTED' AND j.normal_rollback_action_id IS NULL AND j.batch_id IS NULL
